mission: Illustrative rehearsal only: design one alert-detail interaction, including a corrected-source state, for an existing Mastermind screen.
why: An agent must preserve useful analytical depth while making the immediate user action obvious.
user_journey: A researcher opens an alert, understands why it matters and how fresh it is, inspects evidence, and returns to the original context.
machine_outcome: An engineer receives component mappings, data requirements, interaction states and inspected design evidence.

non_goals: This example does not assign a production screen or grant a Paper mutation.
No new design bridge, framework, or branding.

inputs: An approved target document and source screen would be supplied by their existing owners.
Representative lawful alert data must cover empty, partial, stale, corrected and long-text cases.

data_contract.time: Source references are exact commits. Vendor and host observations are dated evidence, not an evergreen health claim.
data_contract.missing: Unknown runtime, workspace, auth, and provider readiness stay unknown; null bindings are authoring-only.
data_contract.corrections: Recompile when mission or method bytes change. These hashes are not canonical capability-generation or authorization receipts.
data_contract.rights: Use original playbooks, public source metadata and official documentation. Do not publish credentials, private captures, or account homes.

deterministic: Validate a closed brief shape, exact source SHA syntax, bounded input and normalized relative paths.
Compile the common method and exactly one role, with reproducible authoring hashes.
model: Synthesize the user and machine outcomes, preserve existing owner boundaries, and define useful role-specific acceptance.

deliverables: User flow and complete state matrix.
Approved design reference and inspected screenshot bytes when a real canary is admitted.
JSX/component mapping and real API-field handoff.
acceptance: The primary action is understandable on narrow and wide layouts.
Unknown data does not render as zero or fresh.
A real design edit, screenshot and JSX extraction must be separately proven before any live design-to-code claim.
stop_conditions: Any requested effect overlaps an incumbent source owner.
A modifying response becomes ambiguous or a required tool/policy gate is unavailable.
The next step requires actual runtime admission, provider enrollment or app authorization absent in this session.
resource_constraints: Use one reserved design writer per desktop context until stronger isolation is proven.
Stay within actual observed account/tool limits.

continuation.record_owner: Owning screen repository and existing organizational workstream; no parent is invented by this example.
continuation.next_action: After actual owner assignment and tool/resource admission, inspect the intended document, execute one bounded design slice, and hand its evidence to the existing frontend owner.
